description: Foundation: design system tokens, complete data layer, SVG brand assets, shared UI components, and full application shell with routing. This covers plan Phases 1-4. All subsequent FEATs depend on this one being complete.
steps: PHASE 1 — Design system: Replace tailwind.config.js with full configuration: set darkMode to ['selector', '[data-theme="dark"]'], extend colors with ALL CSS variable mappings (bg, surface, elevated, border, text, text-muted, primary, primary-hover, primary-soft, success, warning, danger), add fontFamily.heading/body, borderRadius.card/btn, boxShadow.sm/md/lg, backgroundImage.gradient-brand, animation/keyframes for fade-in, slide-up, slide-in-left, skeleton-pulse, bounce-gentle. Create src/styles/tokens.css with full :root (light) and [data-theme='dark'] token definitions from spec §4. Create src/styles/global.css with base resets, scrollbar styling (orange thumb), selection colour (orange), noise texture utility class .texture-noise, prefers-reduced-motion rule, KaTeX CSS import. Update src/index.css to: @import './styles/tokens.css'; @import './styles/global.css'; then @tailwind directives.

PHASE 2 — Data layer: Create src/lib/db.ts with Dexie v4 database class ThinkrDB. Schema version 1 stores: 'studentProfile' (&id), 'pdfDocuments' (&id, subject, type, status), 'textChunks' (&id, docId, pageNumber), 'chatSessions' (&id, subject), 'chatMessages' (&id, sessionId, role, timestamp), 'quizResults' (&id, subject, timestamp), 'marksEntries' (&id, uploadedAt), 'chapterMastery' (&id, subject), 'dailyPlans' (&id), 'flashcards' (&id, subject, nextReviewDue). Export db singleton and typed useLiveQuery wrappers. Add examDates field to StudentProfile: 'examDates?: Array<{subject: string; date: string}>'. Create src/lib/pdf.ts: processPDF(file, onProgress) using pdfjs-dist v4 (GlobalWorkerOptions.workerSrc = new URL('pdfjs-dist/build/pdf.worker.min.mjs', import.meta.url).href), per-page text extraction, Tesseract.js OCR for pages <50 chars (createWorker(['eng', 'hin'])), chunking to 300-500 words with page numbers, thumbnail via offscreen canvas. Create src/lib/search.ts: buildIndex(chunks) returns MiniSearch instance with fields ['text'], searchChunks(query, index, topK=4) returns TextChunk[]. Create src/lib/llm.ts: streamChat(payload, onDelta, onDone, onError) — POST /api/chat, SSE stream reader, auto-fallback on 429/5xx with 1s/2s/4s backoff; buildSystemPrompt, buildMarksPrompt, buildQuizPrompt, buildFlashcardPrompt, buildPlannerPrompt functions. getStreamChatFn() returns demoLLM.streamChat when demoMode true. Create src/lib/voice.ts: startSTT, stopSTT, speak with sentence boundary highlighting, graceful no-op when API absent. Create src/lib/spaced.ts: SM-2 updateCard, getDueCards, calculateMastery. Create src/lib/xp.ts: XP_TABLE (10 levels), awardXP(action), getLevelFromXP, getBadges with 10 badge definitions. Create src/lib/utils.ts: cn(...classes) using clsx + tailwind-merge. Create src/data/boards.ts: BOARDS array — all boards from spec §7 plus ALL remaining Indian state/UT boards (complete list, not excerpt). Create src/data/subjects.ts: getSubjects(classLevel, board) — Math, Science (Physics/Chemistry/Biology from class 8), Social Science, English, Hindi, Computer Science, Sanskrit, EVS where applicable. Create src/data/demo.ts: DEMO_DATA and seedDemoData(db) with rich seed data for all pages. Create src/store/appStore.ts: Zustand persist store with theme, demoMode, sidebarOpen, language. Create src/store/chatStore.ts: Zustand store with activeSessionId, messages, isStreaming, streamingContent, mode, level, scopeDocIds, scopeSubject and all actions. Create src/store/uiStore.ts: Zustand store with hootExpression, confettiActive, toasts and actions.

PHASE 3 — SVG assets: Create src/assets/logo-light.svg — original SVG: rounded rect (rx=18) with orange gradient fill, minimal lightbulb icon (teardrop shape, filament as a small spark/graduation-cap squiggle), wordmark 'Thinkr' in Plus Jakarta Sans 800 weight, dark text (#1A1208). Create src/assets/logo-dark.svg — same icon, wordmark in white (#F5F5F5). Create src/assets/logo-icon.svg — icon only, 48x48 viewBox, for compact use. Update public/favicon.svg to match logo-icon.svg. Create src/assets/hoot/hoot-thinking.svg — round owl head, two ear tufts, large eyes with round glasses frames (orange), slightly tilted head, wing touching chin, small thought bubble. All in orange/white palette. Create src/assets/hoot/hoot-happy.svg — same owl base, wide crescent smile, eyes curved upward (happy crescents), wings raised. Create src/assets/hoot/hoot-celebrating.svg — party hat on head, wings raised high, small confetti dots, big open smile. Create src/assets/hoot/hoot-sleeping.svg — eyes closed (curved lines), small Zzz text near head, wings folded. Create src/assets/hoot/hoot-encouraging.svg — one wing raised as thumbs-up gesture (or wing pointing up), confident smile, slight lean forward. Create src/components/hoot/HootMascot.tsx — React component: props expression ('thinking'|'happy'|'celebrating'|'sleeping'|'encouraging'), size ('sm'=48px|'md'=80px|'lg'=120px), animate (boolean). Import correct SVG per expression. AnimatePresence crossfade on expression change. Reads expression from uiStore when no prop given.

PHASE 4 — Shared UI components: Create src/lib/utils.ts (if not already done in Phase 2). Create all shadcn-style components in src/components/ui/: button.tsx (CVA variants: primary=orange gradient, secondary=outline, ghost, danger; sizes sm/md/lg; 44px min height on md/lg), card.tsx (surface/elevated variants, 20px radius, appropriate shadow), badge.tsx (default/success/warning/danger/muted), input.tsx (orange focus ring, error state, label slot), select.tsx (Radix Select styled), dialog.tsx (Radix Dialog, 20px radius), tabs.tsx (Radix Tabs, orange active indicator), progress.tsx (Radix Progress bar + ring variant), switch.tsx (Radix Switch, orange), tooltip.tsx (Radix Tooltip), skeleton.tsx (pulsing bg animation), toast.tsx (Radix Toast, 4 severity variants), index.ts (re-exports all). Create src/components/layout/ThemeProvider.tsx — reads appStore.theme, syncs data-theme on <html>, listens to prefers-color-scheme, 200ms transition. Create src/components/layout/ThemeToggle.tsx — animated sun/moon SVG toggle with Framer Motion rotate+scale. Create src/components/layout/Header.tsx — logo, XP/level pill (animated counter), streak flame + count, theme toggle, responsive compact on mobile. Create src/components/layout/Sidebar.tsx — desktop only, collapsible icon/full, nav items (Home/Tutor/Study/Library/Progress/Profile) with NavLink active states, Framer Motion collapse animation. Create src/components/layout/BottomTabBar.tsx — mobile only, 5 tabs (Home/Tutor/Study/Progress/Profile), 44px+ tap targets, orange active indicator, safe-area-inset-bottom. Create src/components/layout/AppShell.tsx — ThemeProvider + Header + Sidebar + Outlet + BottomTabBar + DemoBanner; checks db profile, redirects to /onboarding if none. Create src/components/layout/DemoBanner.tsx — orange sticky banner, 'Exit demo' button. Update src/App.tsx — BrowserRouter with all routes: / (LandingPage), /onboarding (OnboardingWizard), /app/* (AppShell with nested routes for /app/home, /app/tutor, /app/study, /app/library, /app/progress, /app/profile, /app/how-it-works). React.lazy + Suspense for all pages. Create placeholder page components in src/pages/ for pages not yet implemented: each exports a default component with just the page name as text so routing works.
acceptance_criteria: npm run build:typecheck exits with 0 TypeScript errors
npm run build completes without errors and produces dist/
tailwind.config.js has darkMode: ['selector', '[data-theme="dark"'] and all CSS variable color mappings
src/lib/db.ts exports a ThinkrDB Dexie instance with all 10 tables from spec §2
src/lib/llm.ts exports streamChat and all build*Prompt functions
All 5 Hoot SVG expressions exist in src/assets/hoot/ as valid SVG files
src/components/ui/ contains all 12 base components (button, card, badge, input, select, dialog, tabs, progress, switch, tooltip, skeleton, toast)
src/App.tsx renders a working router with all routes defined and lazy-loaded pages
Theme toggle (sun/moon) in Header switches data-theme on <html> with 200ms transition
